settled: Native isolated rereading confirms שבעים שבעים, ששה עשר ששה עשר AND היטיב היטיב; prior deletion proposals rejected. They are present in the XML.
Fresh isolated reading confirms קֹדֶשׁ: dot above qof is holam, long lower stroke is qof descender; neighboring segol belongs to dalet. No hataf-qamats substitution.
Native tight images settle both שלמזבח occurrences with lamed and mem dageshes and patah under lamed.

שְׁיָרֵי is printed in all three occurrences; source בכלי uses hiriq under lamed; defective שפך and חצת retained at their actual places.
Printed אֶחָת retained in sic and corrected to intended אַחַת in corr; other spelling/vocalization variants kept as source words.
Primary omitted Num28:9–10 accents in first pass. Supplementary source adjudication restores printed accents, with two exact shapes awaiting human confirmation.
בּוֹטֵחַ is plene in Ps84:13; both initial readings omitted the vav, and native-image adjudication restores it.
החלבנה is printed without the prefixed vav in the first unpointed incense paragraph.
Human confirms וִירוּשָׁלָֽיִם: second yod, qamats+meteg on lamed and hiriq on second yod.
Human confirms pe WITHOUT dagesh in פְנֵה, darga on samekh in סֹ֧לֶת, tevir on chet in מִנְחָ֛ה, attribution as transcribed, and maqaf in עַל־בֵּין.
Samekh in איינגעסאַלטעט is authoritative. Final letter of פֿאָלגענדע־ remains uncertain; tentative ז is explicitly low-certainty, not normalized to modern German.
